description: This file defines FastAPI exception handlers for HTTP and WebSocket request validation errors, providing custom responses for different exception scenarios.

methods.name: Response http_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: HTTPException)
methods.description: Handles general HTTP exceptions by creating appropriate Response or JSONResponse based on the exception's status code and headers.

methods.name: JSONResponse request_validation_exception_handler( request: Request, exc: RequestValidationError )
methods.description: Handles FastAPI request validation errors and returns a JSON response with error details.

methods.name: None websocket_request_validation_exception_handler( websocket: WebSocket, exc: WebSocketRequestValidationError )
methods.description: Handles WebSocket request validation errors by closing the WebSocket connection with a specific code and error reason.

ctags.name: http_exception_handler
ctags.pattern: /^async def http_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: HTTPException) -> Response:$/
